description: All French public money in Insee national accounts (State, State operators, local authorities, social security) by sector and by function, compulsory levies, European comparisons and quarterly debt. Pass `family` for one family's detailed accounts. Family etat covers all State administrations in national accounts, not the State's general budget: use get_state_budget for that. For securite-sociale, section socialAccounts gives the social security branches, ONDAM, health payers, pensions, family benefits and unemployment insurance.

section.description: Part to return. Without it, the headline figures and the list of sections.
